newsitem.title: USA: GTECH says to buy NTN for $140 mln.
newsitem.headline: GTECH says to buy NTN for $140 mln.

text.p: WEST GREENWICH, R.I., June 18 - GTECH Holdings Corp said Wednesday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire NTN Communications Inc for about $140 million.
The letter calls for GTECH to pay $5.125 per share in cash for NTN stock, and the difference between $5.125 per share and the exercise price of outstanding NTN warrants and options.
NTN's shareholders and warrant and option holders may elect to receive part of the payment in shares of LearnStar Inc, a wholly owned unit of NTN, GTECH said.
Shares in NTN closed Tuesday at 3-3/8 and GTECH closed at 33-5/8.
In connection with the letter of intent, GTECH said it agreed to lend NTN $3.7 million to fulfill NTN's obligation to Symphony IWN Investment LLC.

GTECH supplies computerized on-line lottery products and services. NTN, based in Carlsbad, Calif., operates interactive entertainment games for restaurants and bars, on-line services and cable television.
